description: Build script for the TensorFlow project's CI build process on an Ubuntu 16 GPU environment. It sets up environment variables, sources common scripts, installs build tools, and runs Bazel tests with specific configurations and filters. It also analyzes the build profile and copies logs for reporting.

methods.name: install_bazelisk
methods.description: Installs the Bazelisk build tool used for Bazel installation and management.

methods.name: maybe_skip_v1
methods.description: Determines whether to skip V1 tests based on environment or configuration.
